title: EventsDeliveryAdminRequest
description: events.delivery-admin-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/deliveries/replay on OpenVibe.Events (events.delivery.admin, operators): { subscription_id } and exactly one of from_seq (requeue everything the subscription matches from that seq) or event_ids (at most 1000). GET /api/v1/deliveries?status=&subscription_id=&after_seq=&limit= takes no body.
